model_interpretation.claim: Replacing the data-dependent bit loop with fixed-width SWAR arithmetic should reduce work per population count while preserving the exact scalar count. The recurrence remains serial and ordered, with uint32_t wraparound and output overwrite unchanged. Whether this beats compiler lowering of the naive loop is unverified and must be measured.

items.subject: Portable SWAR population count
items.objective: In src/candidate.cpp, investigate branchless fixed-width SWAR as a portable alternative to the naive bit loop. Verify exact counts for every uint32 value and preserve the ordered recurrence, uint32 wraparound, generic valid dimensions, output overwrite, and threads budget. Measure under the frozen build and official protocol; do not assume this combines well with other changes.
